items.text: Folio3 vs Velosio: An Honest Microsoft Partner Comparison

Weighing Folio3 against Velosio for your next Microsoft project? Here is a straight, sourced look at where each partner is strong — Velosio’s broad Dynamics 365 and NetSuite ERP practice, and Folio3’s Azure cloud, data and AI engineering — so you can choose with confidence.
Talk to a Folio3 Azure Expert

items.text: Folio3 vs Velosio: Side-by-Side

Both are recognized Microsoft partners — they simply lead with different strengths. Velosio centers on Business Applications and ERP implementation; Folio3 centers on Azure cloud, data engineering and AI. All Velosio figures below are drawn from public sources as of July 2026.
Velosio
Center of gravity: Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Oracle NetSuite ERP and CRM implementation.
Microsoft standing: Solutions Partner across all designations, Business Applications Inner Circle 2025–2026, and 2023 Dynamics 365 Business Central US Partner of the Year.
ERP coverage: Dynamics 365, Oracle NetSuite, and legacy Dynamics AX, GP, NAV and SL.
AI and data: Power BI and Copilot delivered within the Microsoft and NetSuite stack.
Team and reach: 450 professionals and 10,000+ projects, US-based (HQ Atlanta, GA).
Pricing: quote-based; Clutch lists indicative rates of roughly $100–$149/hour and a $10,000+ project minimum.
Folio3
Center of gravity: Azure cloud, data engineering and AI/Copilot, plus Microsoft business solutions.
Microsoft standing: Microsoft Solutions Partner and Tier-1 Cloud Solution Provider with 200+ Microsoft-certified experts.
ERP coverage: Azure-native data platforms, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI and custom line-of-business apps.
AI and data: dedicated AI and Copilot agents plus Azure data engineering as a core, in-house practice.
Team and reach: 700+ global employees across 7+ offices worldwide, with 5,000+ projects delivered.
Pricing: quote-based and consultative, scoped to each engagement.
Where Velosio Is a Strong Choice
A credible comparison starts by naming what a competitor does well. On these fronts, Velosio is a genuinely strong option.
Broad Microsoft and NetSuite Portfolio

Velosio spans Dynamics 365 (Finance, Supply Chain, Sales, Customer Service, Business Central, Field Service and Project Operations), the Power Platform, Azure and Microsoft 365 — and, unusually, also implements Oracle NetSuite. If you want one partner covering several ERP lines, that breadth is a real strength.
Deep ERP Implementation Heritage

Velosio describes 30+ years of experience and more than 10,000 completed projects, with support extending to legacy Dynamics AX, GP, NAV and SL. For long-running ERP modernizations, that depth of implementation history counts.
Top-Tier Microsoft Recognition

Velosio is a Microsoft Business Applications Inner Circle member for 2025–2026 and was named 2023 Dynamics 365 Business Central US Partner of the Year — strong signals of standing in the Microsoft Business Applications community.
Strong Client-Review Signals

On Clutch, Velosio holds a 4.8/5 rating across 6 reviews, with clients citing responsiveness, Microsoft-ecosystem expertise and communication. (On G2 the profile shows 4.0/5 from just 2 reviews — a small sample worth reading in context.)
Where Folio3 Stands Apart
If your roadmap runs through Azure cloud, data and AI rather than packaged ERP alone, Folio3’s engineering-led model is built for it.
Azure Cloud and Infrastructure Engineering

Folio3’s Azure practice handles complex cloud infrastructure, migration and app modernization end to end — Windows and Linux workloads, hybrid environments and managed services — as a Tier-1 Microsoft Cloud Solution Provider.
Data Analytics and Microsoft Fabric

From Microsoft Fabric and Power BI to data warehousing and visualization, Folio3 builds the analytics backbone that turns scattered data into decisions, delivered by a dedicated data-engineering team.
AI and Copilot Agents

Folio3 ships production-grade AI and Microsoft Copilot agents — from conversational IT asset management to expense and recruitment automation — engineered on your own data, not just off-the-shelf dashboards.
Global Delivery Scale
With 700+ employees across 7+ offices worldwide, 200+ Microsoft-certified experts and 5,000+ projects delivered, Folio3 pairs engineering depth with the scale to staff large programs.
Which Partner Fits Your Project?
Neither firm is a one-size-fits-all answer. Use the split below as a quick gut-check for your own roadmap.
Consider Velosio If You Need Broad ERP
Your priority is a broad Dynamics 365 or Oracle NetSuite ERP implementation and you want a US-based Business Applications specialist with deep multi-ERP heritage.
Consider Folio3 If You Need Azure, Data or AI
Your project centers on Azure cloud, data engineering, analytics or custom AI and Copilot solutions and you want an engineering-led Microsoft partner with global delivery scale.
